answer: Written in a economic framing, incentive alignment focus register, it stays short. By the lantern of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows. The yarrow holds work receipts rather than names, so the tundra of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
